description: This file defines data structures and functions for supporting configuration schemas in a Swift application. It includes enums, structs, and functions to parse, navigate, and handle configuration schema nodes, UI hints, and path-related operations.

methods.name: init(raw: [String: Any])

methods.name: init?(raw: Any)
